gold_sql:
SELECT p.*, elev.z AS elevation
FROM pois p
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, p.geometry::geometry) AS z
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.976492 39.962826)',4326)::geography, 2200)
  AND p.amenity = 'restaurant'
  AND elev.z >= 40;

  SELECT 
    ST_Buffer(geom, 2200) AS geom
  FROM cafe_location
),
elevation_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(
      rast,
      ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-82.976492 39.962826)'), 4326), 3857)
    )
),
elevation_analysis AS (
  SELECT 
    (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Clip(rast, ST_Transform(buffered_area.geom, 4326), TRUE))).mean AS avg_elevation
  FROM 
    elevation_clip, buffered_area
),
valid_restaurant AS (
  SELECT 
    poi.poi_name,
    poi.geometry
  FROM 
    pois poi

    )

)
SELECT

FROM 
  valid_restaurant vr,
  elevation_analysis ea
